answer: RF time-of-flight multilateration resists Sybil attacks through spatial exclusion. Verifier anchors issue random challenges and measure propagation delays to localize each agent, rejecting keys within the same radius. Because speed-of-light bounds prevent one host from acting as a Sybil haven, costs spiral as each identity requires separate radio hardware in a distinct zone. However, multipath reflections off a concrete jetty skew delay estimates and cause false rejections.
